title: 1.3.6 Identify Purpose Mini-assessment
description: Check your understanding of 1.3.6 Identify Purpose.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: Which criterion specifically addresses listed input purposes for information about the user?
elements.feedback: 1.3.5 has that narrower scope; 1.3.6 addresses components, icons and regions.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: What purpose can a nav element expose?
elements.feedback: Native nav semantics identify a navigation region.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Does naming one icon button prove every page purpose is programmatically determinable?
choices: No, assess all applicable components, icons and regions
Yes, one named button is sufficient
Yes, if the icon is colorful
elements.correctAnswer: No, assess all applicable components, icons and regions
elements.feedback: Each relevant purpose needs evaluation; one named control does not establish page-wide conformance.
